## Change

Describe the problem, implementation, and user-visible effect.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant Android/WebXR hardware behavior was tested, or the limitation is stated.
- [ ] No capture ZIP, photo, point cloud, credential, generated model, or private device report is included.
- [ ] New or adapted third-party material has its provenance and license recorded.
- [ ] Any privacy or network-data-flow change is explicitly documented.
- [ ] Raw WebXR observations remain separate from derived or refined data.
